title: Aether's Delight Missing Recipes
description: Fixes some missing recipes in the Aether's Delight mod.
body:
Adds recipes for the [Aether's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-aethers-delight) mod for:

- Smelting 1 Raw Arkenium Ore to make 1 Arkenium Ingot
- Blasting 1 Raw Arkenium Ore to make 1 Arkenium Ingot
- Crafting 1 Block of Raw Arkenium from 9 Raw Arkenium
- Crafting 9 Raw Arkenium from 1 Block of Raw Arkenium
